sections.title: Output review history
sections.sql: select id,version,data_version,sha256,decision,reviewer,superseded from output_register where job_id=$1 order by created_at

sections.title: Versions
sections.sql: select version,body,editor,note,source_format,source_hash from template_versions where template_id=$1 order by version

sections.title: Decisions
sections.sql: select v.version,r.reviewer,r.decision,r.evidence,r.review_due from template_reviews r join template_versions v on v.id=r.version_id where v.template_id=$1 order by r.created_at

name: retention-record
title: Personal-information retention review
for_each: select id,name from jobs where privacy='personal'

sections.title: Review facts
sections.note: The operator chooses the retention period. This record is not a legal compliance certificate.

sections.title: Stored output copies
sections.sql: select id,created_at,sha256 from outputs where job_id=$1 order by created_at
